model.architecture: Dense decoder (spark2_5 remote code, 36L, hidden 2560, 16 query / 4 KV heads of 256, sliding-window(512) x3 : full x1, per-head sigmoid attention-output gate, exact-GELU gated MLP, 131,072-entry tied vocab); reasoning model that works problems inside <think>...</think>, thought channel declared in bundle metadata and the think opener pre-filled by the bundle's Jinja generation prompt

session_defaults.notes: Reasoning model: give it a generous output budget (>=2048; 3584 for math) - truncated mid-thought it produces no final answer. The declared thought channel routes reasoning out of the streamed answer and makes a thinking budget effective; enable_thinking=false renders the vendor's no-think prompt. Vendor sampling recommendation temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95; all card numbers are greedy.

variants.quantization: export-time int4 blockwise-128 + OCTAV on linears, int8 embedding in its own section (EXTERNALIZE_EMBEDDER: tied vocab); prefer_activation_type fp32 declared in-bundle - GSM8K (same harness) 94 vs bf16 94 (paired: both 91, bf16-only 3, int4-only 3); 8Q 8/8 cpu + 8/8 gpu

recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 (2026-09-07, 2 runs per cell): CPU 35-86 tok/s prefill / 5.5-5.6 decode at 3536 MB peak against GPU 43-56 / 4.9 at 1960 MB (full OpenCL delegation, 2233/2233 nodes; fp32 activations declared). Same-device control taken: the fp32 GPU path does not beat the CPU on Adreno, so CPU for speed; GPU is the lower-memory path (~1.6 GB less peak)

platform_notes: Same template / start_token / tokenizer notes as the int8 file; block-128 with the embedder in its own section (main section 1.994 GiB); iPhone 17 Pro (this shipped file) composite 8Q 7/8 Metal GPU (init 5.3 s, available-memory floor ~2.0 GB) + 7/8 CPU (init 9.0 s), the miss being the composite-format rhyme artifact

variants.quantization: export-time dynamic int8 on linears + embedding (dynamic_wi8_afp32); prefer_activation_type fp32 declared in-bundle (with the runtime's default fp16 GPU activations this file scored GSM8K 84 - the same weights on fp32 activations score 94) - GSM8K (n=100, greedy, 0-shot CoT, 3584 output tokens, own harness) 94 vs bf16 94 (paired: both 92, bf16-only 2, int8-only 2); 8Q 8/8 cpu + 8/8 gpu (bf16 8/8)

recommended.reason: on the Galaxy S26 (2026-09-07) the CPU path measured 65-102 tok/s prefill / 4.5-4.7 decode at 5553 MB peak; the GPU path loads with full OpenCL delegation (2236/2236 nodes) and answers the gate prompt, but its benchmark turn (a ~3,900-token thinking response at roughly 5 tok/s under fp32 activations) exceeded the 20-minute leg cap, so no GPU speed row exists - the int4 sibling is the Android file for this model

platform_notes: Tested on litert-lm 0.17.0 (macOS CLI + python API)

GPU runs with fp32 activations (declared in-bundle): under the runtime default fp16 the 36-layer decoder loses reasoning accuracy (GSM8K 84 vs 94 on the same weights); expect a larger GPU memory footprint than an fp16-activation file of the same size

Jinja prompt template carried verbatim (vendor format: default system block, every message wrapped <｜start▁of▁sentence｜>...<｜end▁of▁sentence｜>, generation prompt <|Bot|><think>); tool-call formatting not carried; stop id 1; KV budget 4096, 6 prefill signatures (1024, 256, 64, 16, 4, 1)
No start_token: add_bos_token is false and the template carries its own BOS per message

Single 4.24 GB TFLite section; loads and generates on the iPhone 17 Pro as well (this shipped fp32-activation file, G41DeviceTest harness with the Increased Memory Limit entitlement, iOS 27: composite 8Q 8/8 Metal GPU in 74 s wall, init 2.9 s warm / 18.8 s cold, available-memory floor ~2.6 GB; 8/8 CPU, init 13.2 s, floor ~4.6 GB)
Embeds the upstream HF tokenizer.json (byte-level BPE); engine-vs-tokenizers ids identical on 234/234 probe rows
